detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=oci`.
• Install and configure Splunk Add-on for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure with the modular input for `oci:log`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.7.1.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `logGroup` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=oci sourcetype=oci:log.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=oci sourcetype="oci:log" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=oci sourcetype="oci:log"
| table _time logGroup logContent.data.message
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.7.22_oci_block_volume_attach_22"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `oci:log` in `index=oci` to detect oci block volume attach monitoring. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the provider cloud console audit view for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `logGroup` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_7_22_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Splunk Add-on for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
